verdict.rationale: Microsoft's docs explicitly document 'Agent slash commands' as a supported capability for Teams apps/bots (ms-teams-docs-6/28), giving developers a way to register commands invoked from the message box. However, this is framed narrowly around agents/bots rather than a broad, mature slash-command SDK, and community feedback notes Teams' app/bot integration is more cumbersome than competitors (requiring full Azure/Graph stack) (ms-teams-comm-11), suggesting real but limited developer ergonomics.
